name: Roll Call
summary: One group message splits into a soap bubble per person, each with its own sent, delivered and read
about: A group send for eight people on an arc. Your message lifts out of the box as one wobbling bubble, then splits into a bubble for each person you picked. Each one lands, wraps that person in a shimmering bubble when delivered and pops into droplets when read; a phone that is off waits, a person with no signal fails and gets a Retry button, and the summary bar tracks it all.
how: Tap people on the arc to leave them out or bring them back.
Write one message and press Send (or Enter).
Watch each bubble report Sent, Delivered or Read; Phone off waits, Not delivered shows Retry.
Press Retry to send that person's bubble again.
When everyone has read it the group does a little hop.
